title: Every page is a file on disk
lead: @sveltejs/adapter-static writes one HTML file per page per locale. Upload the directory anywhere — a bucket, a CDN, GitHub Pages — and that is the whole deployment.

entries.title: Entries, not luck
entries.text: The crawler starts at / and follows links. It cannot invent /cs, so every page under [lang] names its own entries.

strict.title: Strict by default
strict.text: The build fails if a route cannot be prerendered, rather than quietly shipping a site with holes in it.

hooks.title: Hooks still run
hooks.text: handle runs during the prerender, which is how each written file gets its own <html lang>.

note.title: Unknown URLs belong to the host
note.text: There is no fallback here, so /anything-else is answered by whatever serves the files, not by this app. If the 404 has to be yours and translated, see locale-router-advanced.
